children.name: Equisetum arvense

children.name: Equisetum palustre
children.description: Equisetum palustre, the marsh horsetail, is a perennial herbaceous pteridophyte belonging to the subclass of horsetails (Equisetidae).

children.name: Equisetum praealtum

children.name: Equisetum pratense
children.description: Equisetum pratense, commonly known as meadow horsetail, shade horsetail or shady horsetail, is a widespread horsetail (Equisetophyta) and it is a pteridophyte.
